concepts.gloss_en: Voice/sound as a mystical aspect (bechinah of kol), linked to throat, heaven, calling out to God
The (plural) voices/sounds — screaming, sighing, shofar, song — collectively an aspect of azzut (boldness); distinct multiplicity, not the singular kol concept

members.note: plural; 'all the voices' as bechina of azzut — different referent and Torah context (lm1:22) from singular kol

notes: Singular קול and plural קולות appear in different Torahs with different associations (kol as throat/heaven voice vs. the multiplicity of voices as azzut). Under-merge preferred; kept separate.
